Metadata.title: SimSoar – Virtual Gliding Community
Metadata.description: Multi-user platform for virtual gliding flights from MSFS, Condor and X-Plane.

Home.heroSubtitle: Upload IGC files from MSFS 2020/2024, Condor or X-Plane. Analyze distance, altitude profile, thermals and OLC points in a multi-user platform.
Home.featureUploadText: Server-side validation, hashing and persistent storage.
Home.featureThermalText: Detection of climb phases and thermal zones from track data.
Home.featureMultiUserText: OIDC sign-in via the central Keycloak realm “flightclub”.
